messages:
eva: heads-up — saw rows from a different org show up in the Runs list for a customer during the UI canary :eyes:
micah: wait what, which canary? console list-render v2?
eva: yeah, the quick-switch + list prefetch rollout we merged an hour ago. repro steps: load /runs, quick-switch org => ghost rows appear for ~2-3s, refresh clears them
jon: can you repro on staging? any console logs or request ids?
eva: repro on staging. grabbed a frontend trace, backend trace id = tx_0abf3c. Also grabbed redis keys while reproing:
```
GET ui:list:uid:12345
-> [ {org:acme, run_id:...}, {org:globex, run_id:...} ]
```
anya: hmm that key shape looks wrong — we're supposed to namespace by org. which PR touched cache key logic?
ryan: fwiw the PR that added prefetch turned list cache into a shared LRU keyed by user_id to reduce duplication across tabs. probably forgot org in key.
jon: that explains short-lived cross-org flashes — frontend reads cached entries then merges with current org filter before refresh; merge step assumes cache is org-scoped
micah: can we mitigate quickly? revert the canary or purge cache?
eva: canary is only 5% but we saw it on a demo session. I triggered a manual rollback in the canary group. deploy-bot: rollback started by @eva. :warning:
deploy-bot: canary rollback complete — traffic back to baseline.
ryan: for a hotfix we can change the cache key to include org_id and add a guarded migration that ignores old keys. quick patch available in #1234
jon: small snippet to fix the key:
```
# old
cache_key = f"ui:list:{user_id}"
# new
cache_key = f"ui:list:{org_id}:{user_id}"
```
anya: also need to audit anywhere we use user-scoped cache for organization visible views (saved-search, runlist, dashboard tiles)
micah: action items:
- ryan: open hotfix PR to include org in key + tests (ETA 1h)
- micah: run redis scan to count affected keys and schedule TTL purge if needed (ETA 2h)
- jon: add a quick e2e reproduction test to catch this class (ETA end of day)
- eva: coordinate customer outreach if we find public customers affected (you already flagged demo)
ryan: FYI I'll include a temporary gate in the frontend that rejects cache merges when org doesn't match. quick guard until server fix lands.
eva: thanks — I'll keep an eye on support for any incoming tickets.
anya: we should also add a telemetry alert: mismatch between cache org and request org > 0 should fire (low-sev)
jon: good call. I'll add a metric and a small tracing tag for cache_org vs request_org.
micah: once hotfix is merged let's do a careful rollout: canary -> 25% -> 100% with monitoring on the new metric and a rollback path
eva: can we also add a short note in the release notes about the bug and the migration? ops/security will want to know given this touched multi-tenant data exposure risk
micah: agreed. tag legal and security so they can triage customer notifications if needed.
ryan: PR opened: r/gh/4567, includes key change + unit tests + frontend guard. starting internal review.
jon: nice. thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: postmortem checklist template created at /incidents/pm-templates/ghost-rows.md (auto)
eva: adding this thread to the incident doc. closing slack thread after actions assigned. :white_check_mark:
